account.signupLede: You get a workspace of your own to start in.
account.signupClosed: Sign-up is by invitation on this server. Ask a workspace owner for an invite link.
account.firstUser: This is the first account: it becomes the platform's Admin.
account.usernameHelp: Optional; made from your email when empty.
account.workspaceNameHelp: Your first workspace, e.g. your project's name. You can rename it.
account.forgotLede: We'll email you a link to choose a new one.
account.forgotSent: If an account uses that address, a link is on its way. It works for an hour.
account.resetDone: Password changed. Every session was signed out.
account.verifyFailed: This link is invalid or expired.
account.inviteInvalid: This invite link is invalid or expired. Ask for a new one.
account.inviteSignInFirst: Sign in or create an account to join.
account.workspacesLede: A workspace is one project: its repositories, tickets, members and settings.
account.noWorkspaces: You are not in any workspace yet. Create one, or open an invite link someone sent you.
account.workspaceSlugHelp: Used in links; made from the name when empty.
account.profileSub: How you appear to the members of your workspaces.
account.passwordSub: Changing it signs out your other sessions.
account.totpSub: A code from an authenticator app at every sign-in.
account.totpScan: Add this account to your authenticator app with the secret (or open the link on your phone), then enter the code it shows.
account.myClaudeSub: Runs of your tickets use it in workspaces set to per-member mode.
account.returnLede: Thanks. Credits show in Billing as soon as the payment provider confirms the payment (usually within a minute).
account.slotCount: {n, plural, one {# parallel run} other {# parallel runs}}
account.inviteGoogle: Continue with Google to join. New here? Your account is created on the spot.
account.totpRequiredAdmin: Two-factor sign-in is required for Admin accounts, so it stays on.
